name: suhasramanand-marketplace
description: Personal Claude Code skills marketplace by Suhas Reddy — production-grade agentic workflows, data platform engineering, streaming agents, SRE incident response, IaC, and DevOps

plugins.name: agentic-orchestration
plugins.description: Production Claude Code agentic patterns: CLAUDE.md architecture, sub-agent YAML frontmatter, PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks, MCP server wiring, orchestrator-worker design, Writer/Reviewer loops, and git-worktree parallelism. Auto-activates when setting up Claude Code projects or designing multi-agent systems.

plugins.name: dbt-data-platform
plugins.description: Production dbt patterns for data platform engineers: MCP server wiring, self-healing pipeline agents (Hiflylabs pattern), text-to-SQL architecture (LinkedIn SQL Bot pattern), Semantic Layer, data contracts, and Lakehouse CI/CD. Auto-activates when writing dbt models, configuring MCP, or building data agents.

plugins.name: kafka-streaming-agents
plugins.description: Production Kafka and Flink streaming agent patterns: Confluent Streaming Agents (Flink SQL), Schema Registry data contracts with CEL/JSONata rules, replayable orchestration, LLM-recommended test rules (Grab Coban pattern), and real-time context engines. Auto-activates when working with Kafka, Flink, Schema Registry, or event-driven agent architectures.

plugins.name: sre-incident-response
plugins.description: Production SRE agent patterns: tiered incident investigation (k8sgpt → HolmesGPT → deep RCA), kagent CRD design for Kubernetes-native agent runtime, OTel tracing for agent workflows, blast-radius assessment, runbook integration, and human gate requirements. Auto-activates when building incident-response agents or discussing on-call automation.

plugins.name: terraform-best-practices
plugins.description: Expert Terraform guidance covering state management, module design, security, CI/CD, and production-grade IaC best practices. Auto-activates when writing or reviewing .tf files.

plugins.name: kubernetes-best-practices
plugins.description: Expert Kubernetes guidance covering pod security, RBAC, networking, resource management, observability, and production-grade cluster hardening. Auto-activates when writing or reviewing K8s manifests.
